source: Modeled routing: the fraction of each origin's US-bound food shipments that transits the strait, from standard liner routings (Asia and the Indian Ocean to the US East Coast via Suez or Panama; Persian Gulf ports via Hormuz; Pacific South America and Asia to the Gulf/East Coast via Panama; Ukrainian and Russian Black Sea ports via the Turkish Straits). Multiplied by the measured Census origin shares (origin-shares.json) to give each commodity's share of US imports that transits the strait. Fractions are judgement calls at the 0.1 level (modeled).
